Section 01: Problem & Solution

The Retail Investor Blindspot

Why existing brokerages fail users during financial emergencies and market crashes.

The Vanity Metric Trap

Over 160M+ Indian demat accounts look only at daily green/red P&L. Apps reward trading frequency instead of solvency. When a -25% market drawdown hits, users lack hedging or downside visibility and panic-sell at market bottoms.

The Emergency Liquidity Gap

Investors rarely map their liquid cash reserves against unexpected medical emergencies or job loss. When an unforeseen expense arises, they are forced to break long-term compounding investments to fund immediate survival.

The FinSight Solution: 5 Core Resilience Engines

Resilience Engine Core Question Answered What It Delivers
1. Resilience Score (0–100) "How financially bulletproof am I right now?" A standardized solvency index combining cash buffer, burn rate, portfolio diversification, and runway into a single health score with explainable drivers.
2. Stress Test Engine "If the market crashes 25% or 40%, what is my exact loss?" Interactive Swift Charts simulating portfolio drawdowns under Mild (-10%), Stress (-25%), Severe (-40%), or custom shocks with per-stock attribution.
3. Emergency Simulator "Can I survive a ₹2 Lakh hospital bill without selling stocks?" Instant life-crisis testing (medical bills, job disruption, vehicle repair) with live safety floor warning markers.
4. Cash Runway Clock "If income stops, how many months until my bank account hits ₹0?" Precise countdown (e.g. 3.0 Months) with a month-by-month cash depletion trajectory chart before equity liquidation is required.
5. Concall AI Analyst "What management risks are hidden in my company's concall?" Parses 60-page earnings conference calls, extracts operational risks and sentiment, and directly bridges company risks into personal stress tests.

Broker Independence: Zerodha Kite + Any NSE & BSE Stock

Users can sync live portfolio holdings automatically via official Zerodha Kite OAuth (100% read-only, bank-grade encryption) OR manually add and model any NSE and BSE stock from our 80+ company catalog or custom ticker inputs.

Key Architectural Innovations

🧪 What-If Stock Simulator (Pre-Trade Testing)

Allows retail users to test buying any NSE/BSE stock (e.g. 50 shares of Tata Motors) *before* placing the trade. It live-calculates portfolio weight, concentration warnings (>25%), and shifts in market crash drawdown.

🔒 Local-First Cryptographic Security

All sensitive financial profiles and credentials are authenticated and encrypted using Apple CryptoKit SHA-256 + Salt. Operates 100% offline with optional cloud database synchronization.

Investor Objection Handling (Killer Q&A)

Q: "How are you differentiated from Zerodha, Groww, or INDmoney?"

A: "Zerodha and Groww are execution brokers—their revenue depends on transaction volume. INDmoney is a passive net-worth tracker. None of them simulate downside risk. FinSight is conflict-free: we don't push trades; our only job is proving whether your net worth can survive worst-case market and life events."

Q: "Will retail users pay attention to downside protection during a bull market?"

A: "Bull markets actually create maximum anxiety around portfolio overexposure and FOMO. Moreover, life emergencies (medical bills, job shifts) occur regardless of the stock index. Our What-If Simulator and Cash Runway give users immediate clarity on every capital allocation decision."

Q: "What prevents a broker from copying this feature?"

A: "Brokers have a severe structural disincentive: warning a user that their portfolio is over-leveraged or encouraging them to hold 6 months of liquid cash directly reduces the broker's trading fee revenue. FinSight's broker-agnostic position is its greatest moat."
